title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Skills and Careers in an AI Economy

questions.text: Which human skill is highlighted in the lesson as remaining essential because AI struggles with nuance, empathy, and creative problem‑solving?
questions.explanation: The narration notes that AI lacks nuance and empathy, leaving emotional intelligence as a vital human capability.

questions.text: The lesson recommends a small, consistent daily learning habit, such as a free introductory AI course, as a practical upskilling step.
questions.explanation: The narration suggests a free introductory AI course with a small daily learning habit as a practical upskilling step.
